[[The Scourge of Vabbi]] }} Go check on the prison of [[Saevio Proelium]] to make sure the [[Titan]] didn't escape. == Quest information == === Objectives === * Verify if the [[Saevio Proelium's Tomb|Tomb of Saevio Proelium]] is intact. * The tomb has been breached! The [[Order of Whispers]] must know right away! * See [[Whispers Acolyte]] for your reward. === Reward === * 2,000 [[Experience]] * 250 [[Gold]] * 10 [[Lightbringer Points]] == Walkthrough == Verify the Tomb of Saevio Proelium has been breached at the [[Monument to the Defeat of Palawa Joko]] in [[Jahai Bluffs]], just outside the [[Command Post]] entrance to the zone. Report to Whispers Acolyte at the [[Chantry of Secrets]] for your reward. == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ;Whispers Acolyte :''"Hello, . The Order of Whispers needs your help. We have devoted our lives to protecting the land and its people from mystical threats, including that of [[Abaddon]]. Most of what we know of the God of Secrets comes from one of his creatures that we captured, at great cost, nearly a hundred years ago. We interrogated this Titan, Saevio Proelium, and when he would no longer aid us, sealed him away in a tomb.'' :''During the recent storms, a great commotion was heard around that tomb. We need someone to go check on '''Saevio Proelium's tomb'''. If something has happened, we are in even more danger that {{sic|should be "than"}} we thought! Be careful, for demons are appearing more frequently, and may be seeking to free the titan. If Saevio Proelium has escaped, there is no telling how dangerous the area could be!" '' {{ offer dialog | accept = I'll investigate the matter. | decline = I would, but I have this weird preoccupation with survival. | ask = Quickly! Go to Saevio Proelium's tomb and investigate! }} === Intermediate dialogue === ;Saevio Proelium's Tomb :''Beware! Here is entombed Saevio Pro- [the rest of the stone is destroyed.]'' ;Whispers Acolyte : ''"It is as I feared. Not only has [[Varesh Ossa|the descendant]] of [[Turai Ossa|our greatest hero]] gone mad, one of the servants of Abaddon has escaped! This is grim news. We will need to amass a force. We have been watching you for some time, , and we know of your devotion to the people of this land. The Order of Whispers will be calling on you again."'' === Reward dialogue === ;Whispers Acolyte :''"I have sent word of your findings to my superiors, and they wish me to give you this. The Order of Whispers will speak with you again."'' [[Category:Rewards Lightbringer points]]
